paper.title: VLCP: Vision Language Control Policy Closed-Loop Code Replanning for Robot Manipulation
paper.central_claim: Frozen GPT-5.5 rewriting low-level control code every 50 steps yields tenfold manipulation success and 27.3% recovery at feasible cached-query cost; generated helper modules persist for subsequent reuse.

provenance.notes: anchors_version=v2 (3ececdd11cc3d144); session_id/receipt_ref unavailable to internal worker. Domain hash is sorted relative-path + NUL + bytes of all main/sub cards; expectations hash uses main cards (embedded expectations). No other attempts or seat outputs read.

evidence.quote: The policy is thus closed-loop on observations within a block (the same compiled function gets fresh obs and J each step) and closed-loop on code across blocks (the VLM can rewrite the function at every block boundary).
evidence.support_explanation: Two feedback timescales; fixed policy baseline is still reactive to numeric state.

evidence.quote: If the import fails, the file is reverted and the error is surfaced to the VLM on the next replan.
evidence.support_explanation: Admission is import validity, not success/transfer.

evidence.support_explanation: Author pooled environment success, not our reproduction.

signatures.information: Two RGB cameras, current/previous code and actions, proprioception, privileged object poses and analytic Jacobian.
signatures.operation: Frozen GPT-5.5 rewrites control every K=50; PD/IK executes compiled function against fresh obs every step.
signatures.output: Joint targets and next control block
signatures.conditions: Simulation geometry and calibrated primitive API; 500-step horizon; slow inference tolerated.
signatures.feedback: Current and prior RGB/state/action traces at block boundaries
signatures.selection_rule: Use generated function if valid; runtime fallback/error feedback, not success-selected policy search.
signatures.persistence: Control function persists for K calls, overwritten next boundary.
signatures.failure_boundary: Privileged simulation; 40/55 failed-grasp episodes never recover; loops can exhaust horizon.

signatures.operation: Atomic save/import; revert import failures; inject latest 12 source modules into later replans.
signatures.conditions: No mutable skill state; importable modules; no success gate.
signatures.selection_data: Any replan, not only successful episodes
signatures.later_use: Block B of future prompts; main sweep resets library per task.
signatures.claimed_effect: Reusable repertoire/continual-learning substrate, not measured retained gain.
signatures.failure_boundary: Bad-but-importable modules can persist; no held-out library ablation.

gap.author_gap: Prior code controllers do not rewrite the failing code inside an episode.
gap.checked_gap: Specific recoverability gap versus fixed-code K=T is testable, but blanket claim that open-loop code cannot recover is too strong: its function receives fresh numeric obs each step.

lineage.version: as described in 2608.16978v1; original full texts not fixed

gap.closest_adjacent: Act-Observe-Rewrite between-trial repair; concurrent CaP-Agent0 within-episode repair.
gap.residue: Mid-episode code logic repair with latency and reliable evidence.
gap.stakes: A missed grasp can consume remaining episode horizon.
gap.remaining_gap: Perception realism, call-budget confound, cadence sweep, verified skill retention and multi-seed robustness.
unresolved: Independent verification of predecessor capability absent fixed original texts; no novelty claim certified.

tactic_steps_checked.4: K=T ablation, but extra model compute not controlled

matches.reason: Interpreter/IK resolves numeric execution; concrete runtime feedback revises executable artifact, not merely multiple modules.

rs_pattern.reason: Actual structured executable handoff and verification-feedback loop. Conditioning card read as alternative; canonical substrate/category-transfer tactic is not central, so not assigned.

condition_checks.condition: calibrated primitives and checked numeric handoff

revision_proposals: Consider within-episode control-function rewriting subtype; R05 requires between-trial/model-free deployment, so R05 was read but not assigned.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Executable function is the model-to-IK/interpreter handoff; observed failures rewrite it before episode completion.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: Physics success is not guaranteed by code compilation; privileged poses and slow model loop bound deployability.

claims.baseline/control: Identical K=T fixed controller, including privileged poses
claims.selection_vs_test: 57-task sweep; task-specific library reset; no external held-out design set specified
claims.result/denominator: 20/57 vs 2/57 pooled; Wilson intervals; single trial per task
counterevidence: Extra observations/model calls not equalized; K=T code still has stepwise obs feedback.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author reports benefit of bundled repeated-query rewriting over single-query code under privileged simulation, not unique code-edit mechanism under equal compute.

claims.setting: 75 logged pick-place episodes including additional study runs
claims.selection_vs_test: Post-hoc trace labeling, not held-out mechanism intervention
claims.result/denominator: 55 episodes with failed grasp;15 recover;40 do not
counterevidence: Open-loop 0% by construction is asserted, not measured; numeric reactive controller could in principle recover.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Descriptive recovery association, not proof only code rewriting can recover.

counterevidence: Import validity does not validate skill usefulness.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported simulated closed-loop performance improves over a one-query code condition on fixed tasks with privileged poses. No measured cross-task retained improvement, RGB causality, or real-robot transfer.

G.reason: Concrete failure-code bottleneck and adjacent/concurrent lineage; originals unavailable and no exclusive novelty certified.

M.reason: Two-timescale code repair directly addresses static-code failures; oracle poses and asserted vision-only role weaken assumptions.

X.reason: Detailed prompts/API/library save-revert chain reconstructible; import-only skill admission lacks usefulness gate.

measurement.reason: Environment terminal predicate and all trial counts available; core sweep single episode/task therefore v2 measurement cap 2.

causality.reason: Same-model single toggle useful, but multiplied calls/observations and RGB/numeric channels not separated; 0 recovery argument overstated.

holdout.reason: One simulation/body, no demonstrated construction-disjoint scene transfer; only six-task paraphrases; retained library reset.

statistics.reason: Wilson intervals and reframing repeats plus failure counts; core per-task repeat variance and paired test missing.

cost.reason: Real calls/tokens/cache/latency reported including closed-loop corpus; not dollar-priced or compute-matched and pose channel not costed.
